ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution across approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated in localized scars and distal edge encrustations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation; mid-left lobe displays a cluster of 5-6 circular light-grey rosettes; right lobe displays multiple high-contrast white linear streaks oriented diagonally towards the lower margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped indentation with a calculated internal angle of approximately 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge profile with minor low-amplitude serrations; topography becomes highly irregular and jagged at the distal tips due to dense external biological growth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral upward-sweeping curve, exhibiting concave properties near the notch and strong convex curvature at the outer distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially grouped cluster of circular, low-contrast pixel rings located in the central-lateral region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe, measuring approximately 15-20% of the lobe height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-intensity white calcified clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the superior and lateral margins of both distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-contrast biological encrustations on the extreme lateral edges, altering the expected geometric profile of the fluke tips.
